name: ai.glassflow/tares
title: Tares
description: Always-on AI agents: a software factory for Claude Code, or an AI SRE that watches your systems.

environmentVariables.name: TARESD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Address of the Tares the server talks to. Start one with `tares up`.

environmentVariables.description: Token or API key for a Tares that has auth on. Leave empty for a local Tares without auth.
